categories.name: Mini Bikes
categories.tagline: Raw power in a compact frame

products.name: “Viper” Special Edition TGV Mini Trike
products.description:
The Viper Special Edition is engineered for the adrenaline seeker. Featuring a reinforced TGV red-coated frame, oversized ProTaper bars, and a high-output 200cc engine, this machine delivers brutal performance on any terrain.

Colors: Viper Red #b31d28, Midnight Black #101010, Chrome Silver #c8c6c5

features.title: Handcrafted Precision
features.text: Each Viper unit is individually assembled and stress-tested in our California facility.

features.title: 200cc Adrenaline
features.text: High-torque 4-stroke engine modified for maximum throttle response and drift stability.

features.title: Custom Sleeves
features.text: Proprietary PVC rear wheel sleeves designed for consistent sliding and long-term durability.

products.name: 200CC Drift Trike Go-Kart
products.description:
A drift-first go-kart built around a torquey 200cc 4-stroke and upgraded rear sleeves. Low center of gravity, wide stance, and a chromoly-reinforced frame make it the benchmark for controlled slides.

Available in Red, Black, White, Blue, and Purple.

features.title: Slide Geometry
features.text: Wide rear track and low seat height tuned for maximum lateral G-force.

features.title: 4-Stroke Torque
features.text: Instant low-end grunt that breaks traction on demand.

features.title: Upgraded Sleeves
features.text: Ships with our high-durability PVC drift sleeves pre-installed.

products.name: 212cc Monster Minibike
products.description:
The Monster Minibike pairs a 212cc engine with knobby all-terrain tires and a beefed-up suspension fork. Sixty miles per hour of raw, unfiltered power in a frame you can throw in a truck bed.

Colour options: Matte Black #1a1a1a, Sunset Orange #fb923c

features.title: Raw Power
features.text: 212cc of torque tuned for hills, trails, and everything between.

features.title: Terrain Ready
features.text: Knobby tires and long-travel fork eat gravel, dirt, and mud.

features.title: Truck-Bed Size
features.text: Compact frame loads solo and stores anywhere.

products.name: 200CC Go Kart Dune Buggy
products.description: A go-anywhere dune buggy with full roll cage, bucket seat, and a murdered-out black finish. Available in adult and kids sizing so the whole crew can ride.

features.title: Full Roll Cage
features.text: Welded steel cage with padded harness points for real protection.

features.title: Two Sizes
features.text: Adult and kids frames share the same rugged drivetrain.

features.title: Black Finish
features.text: Powder-coated matte black that shrugs off rock chips.

products.name: 200cc Quad - Black
products.description:
Our flagship quad in stealth black. A 200cc thumper, dual A-arm front suspension, and racks front and rear make it as happy hauling gear as it is tearing up trails.

Comes in Black, Camo and Sand.

features.title: All-Terrain
features.text: Aggressive tread and ground clearance for mud, sand, and rock.

features.title: Utility Ready
features.text: Steel racks rated for 66 lbs of gear, tools, or firewood.

features.title: Electric Start
features.text: Turn-key ignition with backup pull start.

products.name: Drift Sleeve Master Kit
products.description: The same proprietary PVC sleeves we fit to every Viper, packaged as a complete replacement kit with hardware. Fits all Go Cart Grip drift trikes and karts.

features.title: Consistent Slides
features.text: Uniform wall thickness for predictable breakaway every run.

features.title: Long-Term Durability
features.text: Outlasts barrel-cut sleeves by 3x in abrasion testing.

features.title: Tool-Light Install
features.text: Swap both sleeves with a single hex key.

products.name: Venom V3 Trike
products.description:
The third generation of our staged-engine flagship. The Venom V3 runs a 212cc staged build pushing 55 MPH, with hydraulic disc braking and a frame designed for full-lean drifting.

COLOURS
- Venom Green #4ade80
- Midnight Black #101010
- Hazard Lime

features.title: Staged Engine
features.text: Ported head, performance carb, and open exhaust from the factory.

features.title: 55 MPH
features.text: The fastest production trike we have ever shipped.

features.title: Race Geometry
features.text: Steeper head angle for razor-sharp turn-in.

products.name: Scorpion Kart
products.description:
A featherweight chain-driven kart built for tight circuits. At 145 lbs the Scorpion changes direction faster than anything in its class.

Finishes: Raw Steel #8e8e93, Scorpion Red #b31d28

features.title: Featherweight
features.text: 145 lbs wet — the lightest kart in the fleet.

features.title: Chain Drive
features.text: Direct, mechanical power delivery with easy gearing swaps.

features.title: Circuit Tuned
features.text: Stiff frame and quick steering rack for tight courses.

products.name: Nighthawk 500 Quad
products.description: The biggest machine in the fleet. The Nighthawk's 400cc big-bore engine and long-travel suspension are built for riders who outgrew everything else.

features.title: Big Bore
features.text: 400cc of usable torque across the whole rev range.

features.title: Long Travel
features.text: Independent suspension soaks up whoops at speed.

features.title: Trail Dominant
features.text: Full lighting kit for night runs.

products.name: Thunder Slide Drift Kart
products.description: Our first electric drift kart. Instant torque from a 3kW hub motor means the Thunder Slide breaks traction the moment you ask — silently.

features.title: Instant Torque
features.text: 100% torque at 0 RPM — slides start when you say so.

features.title: Silent Running
features.text: Ride at hours combustion machines can't.

features.title: Swap Battery
features.text: Removable pack charges indoors in 3 hours.

testimonials.name: Melissa T.
testimonials.quote: I ordered the 200cc go-kart for my son's birthday and the quality blew me away. The build feels solid, the engine runs smoothly, and assembly was simple thanks to the clear instructions. Definitely recommending this site!

testimonials.name: Daniel Taylor
testimonials.quote: I was nervous about ordering such a big item online, but gocartgrip.shop made it easy. Customer service answered all my questions about spare parts. Shipping was on time, and my quad started right up without a problem.

testimonials.name: James B.
testimonials.quote: If you're looking for high-end drift equipment, this is it. The Viper is a beast and handles like a dream on the tarmac.

testimonials.name: @gravel_king_99
testimonials.quote: The build quality is insane. I've taken my mini bike through literal hell and it just keeps roaring.

testimonials.name: Marcus R.
testimonials.quote: Hands down the best drift trike on the market. Shipping was faster than the trike itself!

testimonials.name: Jaxson Miller
testimonials.quote: Absolute monster of a machine. The low-end torque on the Viper is unmatched. Assembly was straightforward and the build quality feels military grade.
